blog_title: Low Margin High Volume T-Shirt Business — ₹15 Profit x 10,000 Pcs = ₹1.5 Lakh Monthly Reality
caption:
₹15 profit per piece sounds small—until you sell 10,000 monthly 💰

One printer told us his margin was too low. We asked: how many pieces? Answer: 10,000+ easily. ₹15 × 10,000 = ₹1.5 lakh monthly profit.

Another guy keeps ₹50 margin but moves only 500 pieces = ₹25,000 total.

Volume beats margin every time. Plan your pricing based on what your clients actually buy.

Save this if you're scaling your print business 👇
